tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0235", "detail": "Line 1 'Kopi Bubuk Arabika 1kg' is ordered at unit price 198600 for quantity 4."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "MCB26100421", "detail": "Line 1 bills unit price 220700 (882800 for 4 units), i.e. 22100 per unit above the PO price."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-035#2.1", "detail": "Unit prices are those in Lampiran A and remain fixed for the term of the agreement; the contract search found no contract price for this item."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-035#2.2", "detail": "A price change is valid only via a written addendum signed by both parties, and only prospectively; no such addendum was found."}, {"kind": "goods_receipt", "ref": "GR-2026-0235", "detail": "All 4 units were received on 2026-10-13 at the PO price, so the higher invoiced price is not offset by any other delivery or pricing basis."}], "explanation": "The invoice charges 220700 per unit against a PO price of 198600, and the contract fixes prices at the Lampiran A values with changes possible only through a signed, non-retroactive addendum, of which there is no record, so the excess is an overcharge."}]}
